configuration.hooks: merged from ~/.grok/hooks/*.json, ~/.claude/settings.json (+ .local), ~/.cursor/hooks.json, <project>/.grok/hooks/*.json, <project>/.claude/settings.json (+ .local), <project>/.cursor/hooks.json, [[hooks.<Event>]] in ~/.grok/config.toml, managed/requirements toml, plugins
configuration.double_hooks: measured: all three sources fire together. Each PreToolUse dispatched 4 hooks: global/settings (the user's ~/.claude/settings.json Bash hook, run for both shell calls, not for the write), project/settings (project .claude/settings.json) and project/probe (.grok/hooks, two handlers). Every recorded event appears once from .grok/hooks and once from .claude/settings.json. A pmcp projection that writes Claude hooks into .claude/settings.json and grok hooks into .grok/hooks would run each check twice; the adapter must project into one of them (or disable compat with [compat.claude] hooks = false, a user-level setting).
configuration.hook_env: measured: a .claude/settings.json hook runs with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT set to the project root and PWD at the project root, so a Claude projection's $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR command resolves under grok
configuration.trust: measured: before trust, projectTrusted false and no project hook ran; after /hooks-trust, grok inspect lists 30 .grok/hooks handlers and 15 .claude handlers and they run headless. Trust is folder-wide (MCP, LSP, instructions, skills).
configuration.headless: grok -p '<prompt>' --output-format json -> {text, stopReason, sessionId, usage, num_turns}; --permission-mode dontAsk with --allow rules ran the allowed tools without prompts
configuration.mcp: documented: [mcp_servers.<name>] in <repo-root>/.grok/config.toml or <cwd>/.grok/config.toml (command or url), trust-gated; tools <server>__<tool> via search_tool/use_tool. Not exercised.

events.other_documented: PostToolUseFailure, PermissionDenied, StopFailure, StopCancelled, Notification, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, PostCompact (not triggered in this run)

edit.tool_name: write (matcher alias Write); search_replace for edits (documented)

deny.shape: hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision deny + permissionDecisionReason; the tool result reads 'Hook denied: <reason>' and the model reports it

context.shape: hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext; before_tool context arrives after the call ran, with its results

stop_context.notes: additionalContext on Stop continues the turn, as on Claude: 9 Stop events in one run until --max-turns 10. Policies may return Stop context only when stop_hook_active is false.

ask.notes: decision ask reaches the permission prompt; dontAsk turns it into a deny

failure.notes: hook failures fail open; only an explicit deny blocks

fields_absent: promptId (documented, absent in this headless run)
timeouts: default 5 s; 600 s for Stop, SubagentStop and PostToolUse gates
trust: folder trust (~/.grok/trusted_folders.toml) required for any project hook, including .claude/settings.json; user-level ~/.claude/settings.json hooks run without it

context.notes: pause, broadcast and shared_checkout notices reached the model; held context arrived at the next delivering event

single_dispatch.notes: With claude and grok targeted, pmcp projects only .claude/settings.json; every V2 grok run logged each hook once as runtime grok
